[Unit]
Description=FortiLens restricted management helper
After=docker.service
[Service]
User=root
Group=fortilens
WorkingDirectory=<BASE>/opt/src
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
ExecStart=<BASE>/opt/venv/bin/python -m management.helper --registry /etc/fortilens/registry.json
RuntimeDirectory=fortilens
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
ReadWritePaths=<BASE>/data/control <BASE>/existing /run/fortilens
ProtectHome=read-only
MemoryMax=512M
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=FortiLens independent web management
After=network.target fortilens-helper.service
Wants=fortilens-helper.service
[Service]
User=fortilens
Group=fortilens
WorkingDirectory=<BASE>/opt/src
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
ExecStart=<BASE>/opt/venv/bin/python -m management.app --data <BASE>/data/web --bootstrap-file <BASE>/data/web/bootstrap.token --helper-socket /run/fortilens/helper.sock --helper-key /etc/fortilens/helper.key --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3030 --origin http://127.0.0.1:3030
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=<BASE>/data/web
InaccessiblePaths=-/var/run/docker.sock <BASE>/data/control <BASE>/existing
MemoryMax=256M
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

main-host-failure.refusal: Installation could not read/update required host files or complete a host operation. Review permissions, storage, TLS and service prerequisites. Keep existing state and resume with the same reviewed options; private details are suppressed.

refuse-adopt-missing-compose.refusal: The existing Compose file was not found. No initialization performed.

refuse-adopt-without-project.refusal: --adopt requires the exact --project to preserve its existing Docker volume identity.

refuse-bind-name.refusal: --bind must be a literal local IP address.

refuse-compose-outside.refusal: Compose file must be inside the registered installation.

files.<BASE>/opt/src/management/__init__.py: """Independent FortiLens administrative control plane; monitoring stays portable."""

refuse-invalid-registration.refusal: Existing configuration registration needs review. It was not reinitialized or overwritten; see the migration guide.

refuse-lan-without-tls.refusal: LAN listeners require TLS certificate and key. Loopback/SSH is the default.

refuse-missing-docker.refusal: Missing docker. Install the documented prerequisites or explicitly choose --install-dependencies.

refuse-not-amd64.refusal: This release supports Ubuntu x86-64; monitoring images are pinned for linux/amd64.

refuse-not-linux.refusal: Run this installer as root on an Ubuntu Linux server. It does not modify Windows.

refuse-not-root.refusal: Run this installer as root on an Ubuntu Linux server. It does not modify Windows.

refuse-not-ubuntu.refusal: This release supports Ubuntu x86-64; monitoring images are pinned for linux/amd64.

refuse-origin-path.refusal: Choose a plain HTTP(S) browser origin, without paths, credentials or query parameters.

refuse-partial-other-adoption.refusal: Resume adoption with exactly the original --adopt, --project and --compose-file options.

refuse-partial-other-options.refusal: Resume the interrupted installation with the same options.

refuse-partial-other-source.refusal: The interrupted installation used different source. Restore that source before resuming.

refuse-port-in-use.refusal: The management port is already in use; no service was changed.

refuse-port-range.refusal: Choose a management port from 1024 to 65535.

refuse-prefix-not-empty.refusal: The installation prefix is not empty; nothing overwritten.

refuse-previous-other-origin.refusal: An installation already exists with different access settings. Preserve it and use the documented host change procedure.

refuse-previous-other-source.refusal: Installed source differs. To move the existing installation to this source, run: sudo ./install.sh --upgrade

refuse-registered-other-project.refusal: The existing installation is registered to a different project. Nothing was reinitialized.

refuse-tls-http-origin.refusal: A TLS listener needs an HTTPS origin.

refuse-web-group-is-docker.refusal: The web user must not belong to the Docker group. Correct host permissions first.

refuse-web-user-in-docker.refusal: The web user must not belong to the Docker group. Correct host permissions first.
